thread:
Aria: Quick sync 9am - launch week planning. Need final landing copy variants for Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, and Private deployment page. Also 3 launch social posts and webinar promo. Who's jumping on copy polish?
Ben: I can do social posts + hosted hero variants. Will keep copy concise and dev-focused. Two hero lines: one emphasizing speed, one emphasizing integration.
Renee: I'll draft Dedicated + Private page content. For Dedicated: emphasize predictable throughput, burst policy and SLA. For Private: surface compliance, VPC, and local key management.
Noah: I'll wire up the demo form routing and make sure inbound leads route correctly (Hosted->Product, Dedicated/Private->Enterprise). Also will add 'needs_nda' flag for Private.
Tara: Sales wants a short FAQ on contract length and onboarding for Dedicated. I'll draft 3 bullets.
Aria: Good. For CTAs we want: Hosted = "Get started", Dedicated = "Talk to sales", Private = "Request trial". Webinar CTA: "Register" and gated brief CTA: "Download benchmark".
Ben: Hosted hero candidates: 
- "Get LLM features live in hours"
- "Hosted API: fast generations, simple billing"
I'll A/B the shorter vs. descriptive.
Renee: Draft copy snippets (rough): 
Hosted short: "Hosted API for fast, reliable text generation with pay-as-you-go billing."
Hosted long: "Ship features quickly with a low-latency Hosted API, streaming responses, and simple scaling."
Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput 	6 SLA-backed performance and configurable autoscaling."
Private: "Private deployments with VPC, KMS integration, and audit logs for compliance-sensitive workloads."
Noah: Tiny nit: make sure we consistently use 'Hosted API' and 'Dedicated capacity'. Also keep hero under 9 words when possible.
Tara: FAQ bullets for Dedicated: 
1) Onboarding timeline: 2-4 weeks
2) Contract: monthly or annual commits
3) Support: 24/7 SLA available
Noah: Form snippet I'll use (will post in #devex): 
```html
<input type\="hidden" name\="campaign" value\="launch-apr">
<input type\="hidden" name\="lead_bucket" value\="product">
```
And conditional JS: if(package==\="private\") { set lead_bucket\="enterprise\"; show NDA checkbox }
Aria: Webinar structure: 25m benchmark walkthrough (latency + cost tradeoffs), 20m product demo (Hosted, Dedicated, Private), 15m live Q&A. Promo cadence: 3 posts across LinkedIn & Twitter, and an email to active trialers.
Ben: Social post drafts: 
1) Benchmark tease: "New benchmark: 1.8s median latency on 8k context. See how batching reduces cost by ~2.8x. Register for the briefing."
2) Webinar invite: "Join our 60-min briefing: production inference patterns for teams. Live demo + Q&A. Register."
3) Download CTA: "Get the 1-page benchmark brief: median latency, batching impact, and quantization notes."
Renee: On-page microcopy: include short trust line under hero: "Used in production by startups and enterprises" and a small bullets row: "Hosted API | Dedicated capacity | Private deployment".
Noah: Lead routing rules: 
- If package==\"hosted\" -> tag product-lead, route to product inbox
- If package==\"dedicated\" -> tag enterprise, route to SDR for AE follow-up
- If package==\"private\" -> tag enterprise+needs_nda, route to sales ops; require NDA checkbox on form
Tara: Sales ops also asked: include MRR estimate field for Dedicated in the form (optional). Good to capture ARR intent.
Aria: Design ask: hero mobile constraints = single-line CTA, 16px button height minimum. Ben, can you produce both hero sizes?
Ben: Yep. Also will run a quick heatmap for variant 1 on staging after copy drops.
Renee: I'll add SLA language: "99.9% uptime SLA available for Dedicated capacity, with enterprise support options." Keep it simple.
Noah: I'll post the updated form JSON and GTM tags in #devex when ready.
CommsBot: Reminder: content calendar entry created for webinar on 2026-05-05.
Aria: Action items: 
- Ben: finalize Hosted hero + social posts (due Wed EOD)
- Renee: final Dedicated & Private page copy + SLA blurbs (due Thu)
- Noah: form routing + conditional NDA logic + GTM tags (due Thu)
- Tara: Dedicated FAQ bullets + MRR field copy (due Wed)
We'll reconvene Fri morning to review live Figma pages and social creatives.
